_readme: Every monthly edition on file, newest first. Written by scripts/build-editions.mjs from fivemile-editions/YYYY-MM.json. The news page and the Editions room read this. See DECISIONS.md 74.

editions.title: The August 2026 Edition
editions.lede: August ran about as warm as usual and came in close to normal on rain, and Five Mile Creek never reached the high water line.

editions.title: The July 2026 Edition
editions.lede: July ran about as warm as usual and came in close to normal on rain, and Five Mile Creek rose over the high water line once.

editions.title: The June 2026 Edition
editions.lede: June ran about as warm as usual and came in wet, and Five Mile Creek rose over the high water line twice.

editions.title: The May 2026 Edition
editions.lede: May ran a little cooler than usual and came in wetter than usual, and Five Mile Creek rose over the high water line once.

editions.title: The April 2026 Edition
editions.lede: April ran a little warmer than usual and came in wetter than usual, and Five Mile Creek rose over the high water line once.

editions.title: The March 2026 Edition
editions.lede: March ran well warmer than usual and came in wetter than usual, and Five Mile Creek rose over the high water line twice.

editions.title: The February 2026 Edition
editions.lede: February ran a little warmer than usual and came in close to normal on rain, and Five Mile Creek rose over the high water line once.

editions.title: The January 2026 Edition
editions.lede: January ran a little cooler than usual and came in wet, and Five Mile Creek rose over the high water line twice.
